decisions.reason: The allocated-budget change does not alter the MS 284 start or end dates; those dates are separate clauses already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The allocated-budget change does not alter the MS 284 weekdays or session time slots; those schedule values are separate clauses already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.

The allocated-budget change does not alter the signature requirement or placement; the extension of that signature requirement to MS 284 is already represented by the candidate's same-message scope MODIFY.
